models.definition: six independent process shocks, each shared by four consecutive factor rows, plus independent residuals
one normalized linear row-gradient shock plus independent residuals

decision.supersededProcurementTarget: the iid-only sigma 0.002 target is not retained as the robust headline
decision.robustModelConditionalTarget: sigma at or below 0.0015, or 0.15 percent, keeps the 95 percent Wilson lower yield above 99 percent in both declared correlated models
decision.failureOfOldTarget: at sigma 0.002, row-block and smooth-gradient yields fall to 97.02 and 98.08 percent
decision.qualificationRule: procure or tune to at most 0.15 percent estimated component log scatter until measured platform covariance replaces the surrogate correlation models
decision.devicePassRule: regardless of component scatter, accept only by direct full-matrix inverse-metric residual and covariance propagation

epistemicStatus.conditionalInference: the revised 0.15 percent target is robust across three declared stochastic models, not across all possible correlated errors
epistemicStatus.notEstablished: the two surrogate correlations span the covariance, parasitic, drift or frequency-dependent structure of a real device

established: strong row correlation invalidates the iid-only 0.2 percent procurement headline; 0.15 percent is the largest sampled scatter retaining a greater-than-99-percent Wilson lower yield in both correlated surrogates
boundary: The correlation models are deliberately simple stress tests. They omit arbitrary covariance eigenvectors, additive parasitic capacitance, dissipative admittance, frequency dependence and temporal drift; direct matrix measurement remains decisive.
